n448e4008c0e.s: Legal recognition of electronic signatures is provided by which section of the IT Act, 2000?
n448e4008c0e.x: Section 5 gives legal recognition to electronic signatures; Section 4 covers electronic records.

n1070ae5fe28.s: Which section of the IT Act, 2000 provides compensation for failure to protect sensitive personal data?
n1070ae5fe28.x: Section 43A provides this compensation; Section 4 covers electronic records, Section 5 electronic signatures and Section 66F cyber terrorism.

n305653d01bc.s: CERT-In derives its statutory basis from which section of the IT Act?
n305653d01bc.x: CERT-In falls under Section 70B; Section 70A relates to NCIIPC.

n454e6e190f9.s: Which provision of the IT Act was struck down in Shreya Singhal v. Union of India (2015)?
n454e6e190f9.x: Section 66A was struck down as violating Article 19(1)(a) and not saved by Article 19(2); Section 69A was upheld and Section 79 read down.

neb060116937.s: A record identifying the issuing Certifying Authority is part of a:
neb060116937.x: Such a record belongs to a digital certificate, not to the digital signature itself.

n9ffe93f5f31.s: The Information Technology (Amendment) Act, 2008 added provisions relating to:
o: Creation of the National Cyber Coordination Centre
Setting up of the Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre
Setting up of the Data Protection Board
n9ffe93f5f31.x: The 2008 amendment added video voyeurism, sexually explicit material and data leakage by intermediaries; it did not create the NCCC.

ned0404eecc7.s: The National Cyber Security Policy, 2013 aimed at establishing an:
ned0404eecc7.x: Establishing an Information Security Assurance Framework was one aim of NCSP 2013, separate from its aim of a trained workforce.

n8a53b6772d8.s: CERT-Thermal, CERT-Hydro and CERT-Transmission are sectoral CERTs under the:
n8a53b6772d8.x: The power sector's CERT-Thermal, CERT-Hydro, CERT-Transmission and CERT-Distribution function under the Ministry of Power.

n2afa5567f0b.s: Which Aadhaar linking was upheld in the Aadhaar judgment (2018)?
o: Mandatory linking with both bank accounts and SIMs
n2afa5567f0b.x: PAN/ITR linking under Section 139AA was upheld; mandatory linking with bank accounts and mobile SIMs was struck down.

n6163f33c920.s: Which kind of data is excluded from the DPDP Act, 2023?
o: Data of foreign entities offering goods in India
n6163f33c920.x: The DPDP Act excludes non-personal data, though it covers entities outside India offering goods or services in India.

n4c7d6b829e0.s: Which of the following receives no exemption under the DPDP Act, 2023?
n4c7d6b829e0.x: Journalism gets no exemption; notified State agencies, research, archiving and statistics can be exempted.

n9a090d59d9e.s: India's first national standards for cloud, data centres and ethical AI focus on:
n9a090d59d9e.x: The standards focus on bias, data sovereignty and privacy and are linked to the DPDP Act; spectrum auction pricing is not among them.

new.s: Which section of the IT Act, 2000 deals with identity theft?
new.x: Section 66C covers identity theft; Section 66 covers hacking-type offences and 66D cheating by personation.

new.s: Cyber terrorism, punishable with imprisonment for life, falls under which section of the IT Act?
new.x: Section 66F deals with cyber terrorism; 66E is privacy, 67A sexually explicit material and 69A blocking.

new.s: Blocking of public access to online information is provided under which section of the IT Act?
new.x: Section 69A provides for blocking; Section 69 covers interception and Section 79 safe harbour.

new.s: Under Section 79A of the IT Act, Examiners of Electronic Evidence are notified by the:
new.x: Section 79A empowers the Centre to notify Examiners of Electronic Evidence.

new.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Section 43 – Compensation for failure to protect data
new.x: Section 67A covers sexually explicit material; 66F is cyber terrorism, 69A blocking and 43A compensation.

new.s: Under the IT Rules as amended on 27 March 2026, intermediaries must take down unlawful content within:
new.x: The 27 March 2026 change sets a takedown window of three hours.

new.s: In a digital signature, the document is signed with the:
new.x: The private key signs and the public key verifies the signature.

new.s: A digital signature is based on:
o: Asymmetric cryptography and a hash function
new.x: A digital signature uses asymmetric cryptography together with a hash function.

new.s: CERT-In functions under the:
o: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
new.x: CERT-In works under MeitY; NCIIPC is under NTRO and I4C under MHA.

new.s: Under the CERT-In Directions of 28 April 2022, ICT system logs must be maintained for:
new.x: Logs must be kept for 180 days; VPN subscriber data is kept for 5 years.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the CERT-In Directions, 2022:
1. Government organisations are exempt from reporting incidents.
2. Virtual asset service providers must report incidents.
3. VPN service providers must keep data for 5 years.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: VASPs must report and VPN data is kept 5 years; government organisations are also covered, so statement 1 is false.

new.s: The National Cyber Security Coordinator functions in the:
new.x: The National Cyber Security Coordinator sits in the National Security Council Secretariat.

new.s: Which of the following pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
new.x: I4C functions under MHA, not MeitY.

new.s: Which I4C component is meant for data sharing and joint investigation?
new.x: Samanvaya is for data sharing and joint investigation; SAHYOG handles takedowns and NCAP AI analytics.

new.s: The Cyber Commandos programme under I4C was launched in:
new.x: Cyber Commandos were launched in 2024.

new.s: The Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre became operational in:
new.x: I4C was approved in 2018 and became operational in 2020.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C)?
o: It is headquartered in New Delhi.
It became an Attached Office in 2024.
new.x: I4C is not a statutory body.

new.s: Under the CFCFRMS SOP of January 2026, frozen funds are to be released within:
new.x: The SOP provides for release within 90 days.

new.s: Cyber Jagrookta Diwas is observed on the:
new.x: Cyber Jagrookta Diwas falls on the first Wednesday of every month.

new.s: India observes cyber security awareness month in:
new.x: October is observed as cyber security awareness month.

new.s: How many objectives does the National Cyber Security Policy, 2013 list?
new.x: NCSP 2013 has 14 objectives, including a target of 5 lakh professionals in five years.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh's cyber crime Coordination Centre is located at:
new.x: The Coordination Centre is at Krishnalanka Police Station, Vijayawada.

new.s: Which was the first CERT-In-empanelled body in Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: APTS, which implements the AP Cyber Security Policy 2017, was the first CERT-In-empanelled body in AP.

new.s: The UN Convention against Cybercrime was adopted on:
new.x: It was adopted on 24 December 2024; it was opened for signature at Hanoi in October 2025.

new.s: In October 2025, the UN Cybercrime Convention was opened for signature at:
new.x: The signing took place at Hanoi in October 2025; Budapest is linked to the Council of Europe convention.

new.s: The vision of the National Cyber Security Policy, 2013 is:
o: A secure and resilient cyberspace for citizens, businesses and government
new.x: NCSP 2013 envisions a secure and resilient cyberspace for citizens, businesses and government.

new.s: Under NCSP 2013, the nodal agency for critical information infrastructure is:
new.x: NCIIPC protects critical information infrastructure; CERT-In handles incident response and NCCC situational awareness.

new.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: CERT-In – Incident response and crisis management
new.x: CERT-In handles incident response and crisis management; NCCC is for situational awareness and NCIIPC for critical infrastructure.

new.s: What is the status of India's National Cyber Security Strategy?
new.x: The strategy is still a draft and has not been notified; NCSP 2013 remains operative.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about India's cyber security policy framework?
o: A National Cyber Security Policy 2020 is in force.
The draft strategy was prepared in the NSCS.
The CCMP is a MeitY framework.
new.x: There is no NCSP 2020 in force; 2020 refers to the draft strategy and the 2013 policy remains operative.

new.s: How many Cyber Crisis Management Plan workshops had been held till July 2025?
new.x: 205 CCMP workshops were held till July 2025.

new.s: The Cyber Crisis Management Plan is to be followed by:
new.x: The CCMP is followed by all Central and State Governments.

new.s: Cyber Surakshit Bharat is India's first ____ initiative to train CISOs.
new.x: Cyber Surakshit Bharat (MeitY, 2018) was the first PPP initiative for CISO training.

new.s: The deep-dive trainings under Cyber Surakshit Bharat are run by:
new.x: NeGD runs the deep-dive training under Cyber Surakshit Bharat.

new.s: Cyber Jagrookta Diwas, observed under MHA's I4C, began in:
new.x: Cyber Jagrookta Diwas began in October 2021.

new.s: The #OnlineButUnafraid campaign for women journalists was run by the:
new.x: It is a Telangana Cyber Security Bureau campaign.

new.s: How many participants did Cyber Shakti's advanced (offline) training cover?
new.x: Cyber Shakti had 53 in advanced offline training and 305 in beginner online training.

new.s: The CCPWC scheme is linked to projects under the:
new.x: CCPWC is linked to the National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal and Nirbhaya Fund projects.

new.s: SEBI's Cybersecurity and Cyber Resilience Framework (CSCRF) was issued in:
new.x: SEBI's CSCRF dates to 2024; the RBI banks framework is of 2016.

new.s: RBI's Cyber Security Framework for banks was issued in:
new.x: The RBI framework for banks came in 2016; 2024 is SEBI's CSCRF.

new.s: MeitY's Digital Threat Report 2025-26 for the BFSI sector sets a roadmap of:
new.x: The second edition gives an 18-month roadmap.

new.s: Under the US-led Counter Ransomware Initiative, India leads the:
new.x: India leads the Resilience Working Group of the Counter Ransomware Initiative.

new.s: CERT-In's exercise 'Synergy' under the Counter Ransomware Initiative involved how many countries?
new.x: Synergy was conducted for 13 countries.

new.s: The first APCERT conference was held in March 2002 at:
new.x: APCERT's first conference was held in Tokyo in March 2002.

new.s: The ITU Global Cybersecurity Index 2024 classifies countries by:
new.x: GCI 2024 uses tiers, not ranks; India's rank of 10 was in GCI 2020.

new.s: India's tier in the ITU Global Cybersecurity Index 2024 is named:
new.x: India is in Tier-1 'Role Modelling' with a score of 98.49.

new.s: K.S. Puttaswamy v. Union of India was decided on:
new.x: The nine-judge Puttaswamy judgment came on 24 August 2017; 26 September 2018 is the Aadhaar judgment.

new.s: Which 1975 case held privacy to be part of personal liberty?
new.x: Gobind v State of MP (1975) treated privacy as part of personal liberty.

new.s: Which of the following was NOT upheld in the Aadhaar judgment (2018)?
new.x: Section 57 private-entity use was struck down; the Act, welfare use and PAN/ITR linking were upheld.

new.s: How many judges delivered the Aadhaar judgment of 26 September 2018?
new.x: The Aadhaar bench had 5 judges (4:1), unlike the 9-judge Puttaswamy bench.

new.s: The Personal Data Protection Bill, 2019 was withdrawn in:
new.x: The 2019 Bill was withdrawn in 2022, before the DPDP Act of 2023.

new.s: The 2012 Group of Experts on Privacy was headed by:
new.x: Justice A.P. Shah headed the 2012 Group of Experts on Privacy.

new.s: The 2015 DoT committee on net neutrality was headed by:
new.x: A.K. Bhargava headed the net neutrality committee; A.P. Shah headed the privacy experts group.

new.s: The DPDP Act's 'Data Fiduciary' corresponds under the GDPR to the:
new.x: A Data Fiduciary decides purpose and means of processing, like the GDPR's Data Controller.

new.s: The right to erasure of a Data Principal is in which section of the DPDP Act?
new.x: Erasure is in Section 12 of the DPDP Act; under the GDPR it is Article 17.

new.s: Which of the following is a duty of a Data Principal under the DPDP Act?
new.x: Data Principals must not give false information, impersonate or file frivolous complaints.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about children's data under the DPDP Act, 2023:
1. Verifiable parental consent is needed for persons below 18.
2. Targeted advertising at children is barred.
3. Behavioural monitoring of children is permitted.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Parental consent is needed below 18 and tracking, behavioural monitoring and targeted ads are barred, so statement 3 is false.

new.s: The DPDP Act's amendment of RTI Section 8(1)(j) removed the:
new.x: Section 44(3) lets all personal information be refused and removes the public-interest override.

new.s: Exemption of notified State agencies under the DPDP Act is provided in:
new.x: Section 17 lets the Centre exempt notified State agencies; Section 7 covers legitimate uses.

new.s: Members of the Data Protection Board of India are appointed by the:
new.x: The Centre appoints Board members; appeals lie to TDSAT.

new.s: The maximum penalty for breach of Significant Data Fiduciary duties under the DPDP Act is:
new.x: SDF breaches carry up to Rs 150 crore in the 250-200-150-50 crore ladder.

new.s: The maximum penalty for a Data Principal breaching her duties under the DPDP Act is:
new.x: Breach of Data Principal duties attracts up to Rs 10,000.

new.s: Under the DPDP Rules 2025, the Consent Manager provisions apply from:
new.x: Consent Manager provisions apply from November 2026; full compliance is due by May 2027.

new.s: The draft DPDP Rules were released on:
new.x: The draft came on 3 January 2025 and the final Rules on 14 November 2025.

new.s: The Supreme Court's Pegasus committee found malware on how many of the 29 phones examined?
new.x: Malware was found on 5 of 29 phones, though not clearly Pegasus.

new.s: The GDPR regulates cross-border data transfer through:
new.x: GDPR uses a whitelist/adequacy model; the DPDP Act uses a blacklist.

new.s: AP Police's AI4AP pilot, which raises DPDP issues, covers which districts?
new.x: The AI4AP pilot covers Chittoor, Guntur and Annamayya.

new.s: The Right to Be Forgotten began with which case?
o: K.S. Puttaswamy v Union of India (2017)
new.x: The Right to Be Forgotten began in Google Spain v AEPD (2014).

new.s: The GDPR replaced the EU Data Protection Directive of:
new.x: The GDPR replaced the 1995 Directive.

new.s: Penalties under the EU GDPR are:
new.x: GDPR penalties are financial and criminal, while DPDP penalties are financial only.
